subject: SOC 2 renewal: evidence, retention change, and capacity uplift
messages:
From: Claire Dumas <claire.dumas@criosystems.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ricardo Mendez <ricardo.mendez@criosystems.com>, security@criosystems.com
Date: 2026-12-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: SOC 2 renewal — updated evidence request and retention window

Hi Stephanie,

Hope you're well. We're kicking off our renewal with Redwood and have two items that need to be addressed for our legal/security review: a) the latest SOC 2 artifacts for 2026 (we need either the attestation or the interim evidence bundle), and b) a proposed change to log retention from 180 days to 365 days for audit purposes.

We are also planning a capacity uplift (expected +30% token throughput) starting Jan 15 to support a new feature launch. Legal wants the evidence and a short risk/mitigation note tied to the uplift. Can you confirm Redwood's ability to deliver the SOC 2 package, the retention change, and a statement on how audit logs will be handled during the ramp?

I've attached our gap list and the procurement questionnaire to speed things up.

Thanks,
Claire

Attachments: crios_soc2_gaplist_2026.xlsx (xlsx), crios_procurement_questionnaire.pdf (pdf)

--
Claire Dumas
Head of Security Operations
Crios Systems
claire.dumas@criosystems.com
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Dumas <claire.dumas@criosystems.com>
Cc: Ricardo Mendez <ricardo.mendez@criosystems.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-21T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 renewal — updated evidence request and retention window

Hi Claire — thanks for the note and the attachments. We're aligned to support the renewal and the retention adjustment.

High level:
- SOC 2 attestation package: we can provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II attestation and an interim evidence bundle for items that post-date the report.
- Retention: we can support a 365-day audit-log retention for Crios (this will require a brief contract addendum; see next steps).
- Capacity uplift: +30% throughput looks doable via a reserved burst policy on Dedicated or a temporary seat increase on Dedicated capacity. We can include an uplift pricing cadence in the MA plan.

Can we schedule a 30-minute call this week to walk through the gap list and confirm which evidence artifacts you need immediately? I'll loop legal and finance internally.

FYI attached: Redwood Evidence Playbook (internal reference).

Best,
Stephanie

Attachments: redwood_evidence_playbook_v2.docx (docx)

--
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-21T11:13:00-08:00
Subject: FW: SOC 2 renewal — updated evidence request and retention window

Team — forwarding Crios' note. Summary of asks: attestation/evidence bundle, retention change to 365d, and a capacity uplift ~+30% starting Jan 15. Customer wants a short risk/mitigation statement and finishing the procurement questionnaire.

Ben: can you put together pricing for a 3-month burst (Jan–Mar) and a permanent seat uplift option? Include a recommended canary/fallback plan (we may route to hosted if Dedicated isn’t warmed).

Kimberly/Laura: need legal/finance sign-off on the retention addendum and the SOC evidence delivery timeline (can we deliver the interim artifacts by EOW 12/24?). If we can't hit 12/24, what's the soonest?

I'll book a 30m with Crios for Thurs.

Thanks —
Stephanie
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-21T12:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: FW: SOC 2 renewal — updated evidence request and retention window

Steph — putting numbers below for the call and follow-ups. Quick notes:
- 3-month burst (Jan–Mar) for +30% throughput on Dedicated: $28k flat for burst capacity + prorated consumption.
- Permanent seat uplift (add 5 Dedicated seats): list price $9,500/mo; we can offer a 20% discount for a 12-month commit (to land at $7,600/mo).
- Evidence delivery: ops can assemble the interim evidence bundle by 12/27 if we prioritize exports and logs. Full attestation (if needed) will be the standard SOC 2 report (we have 2026 Type II dated Oct).
- Risk/mitigation blurb (suggested): Redwood will maintain WORM log storage for Crios' audit logs, retain snapshots for 365 days, and enable expedited export within 48 hours for audit review. We'll include an agreed SLA for evidence availability during the uplift.

I'll prepare a short MA amendment with the two pricing paths and the mitigation language for the call.

—Ben
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-22T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: FW: SOC 2 renewal — updated evidence request and retention window

Team — good plan. A few directives:
1) Prioritize producing the interim evidence by 12/27. Ops, please provide a confirmed ETA; if exports require legal review, escalate to me immediately.
2) Approve Ben's pricing approach. For the customer, offer the 12-month discounted commit for long-term predictability, plus a documented 3-month burst addendum for the Jan launch.
3) Amend the contract with a 365-day retention addendum and include the mitigation language Ben drafted. Keep the addendum narrowly scoped to avoid wider T&Cs changes.
4) For the call with Crios, Stephanie: lead the technical walkthrough. Ben: bring the MA amendment draft. Laura: have billing ready with CP export for audit.

I'll join the call for the pricing/contract bit.

Kimberly

--
Kimberly Park
VP, Customer Success & Contracts
kimberly@redwood.ai
From: Ricardo Mendez <ricardo.mendez@criosystems.com>

Date: 2026-12-28T16:43:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 renewal — updated evidence request and retention window

Thanks everyone — call was helpful. We reviewed the draft MA amendment and the mitigation language internally. A few follow-ups:
- Procurement will sign the 12-month seat uplift with the 20% discount pending the retention addendum and evidence delivery.
- Legal requested the 365-day retention addendum as a simple amendment (they liked the limited scope). Please route DocuSign to ricardo.mendez@criosystems.com.
- Security asked for the interim evidence bundle and a short export-playbook (how to request exports and expected lead times). Could you attach/export the interim bundle to the shared S3 link and send the DocuSign link?

Attached: completed procurement questionnaire (signed). DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/12345-crios-renewal

Ricardo
